verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only outbound webhooks that notify an endpoint when a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job or monitor check starts, progresses or finishes. That is a developer building block a user could wire into their own automation, not a product-native way to define rules that trigger actions. Nothing in the pack documents user-defined trigger conditions or automatic actions run by Firecrawl itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
